mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.content_id, c.content_code, c.title, r.account_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, r.publish_mode, r.status, r.planned_time, r.published_time, r.post_url, r.platform_post_id, r.error_msg, cast(r.metrics as text) as metrics, r.metrics_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from abr_publish_record r left join abr_content c on c.content_id = r.content_id left join abr_channel_account a on a.account_id = r.account_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_publish_record (content_id, account_id, publish_mode, status, planned_time, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{contentId}, #{accountId}, #{publishMode}, 'scheduled', #{plannedTime}, #{createBy}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update abr_publish_record set status = 'published', published_time = coalesce(#{publishedTime}, now()), post_url = coalesce(#{postUrl}, ''), platform_post_id = coalesce(#{platformPostId}, ''), error_msg = '', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('scheduled', 'failed')
update abr_publish_record set status = 'failed', error_msg = coalesce(#{reason}, ''), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where record_id = #{recordId} and status = 'scheduled'

update abr_publish_record set status = 'withdrawn', error_msg = coalesce(#{reason}, ''), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('scheduled', 'published')
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_publish_record where content_id in #{id}
where r.status = 'scheduled' and r.planned_time <= #{now} and r.publish_mode = #{publishMode} order by r.planned_time, r.record_id
